hints.title: Think in layers
hints.body: All markers reachable with at most `k` jumps form a contiguous range starting at index `0`.

hints.title: Layer boundary
hints.body: Track the last index of the current jump layer and the farthest index visible from anywhere in that layer.

hints.title: Count when crossing
hints.body: When the scan reaches the current layer boundary, one more jump is needed and a new layer begins.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
jumps = 0
layerEnd = 0
farthest = 0
for i from 0 to length(steps) - 2:
    farthest = max(farthest, i + steps[i])
    if i == layerEnd:
        jumps += 1
        layerEnd = farthest
return jumps
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
